_doc: Single source of the Endfield look. theme/generate.py renders Ghostty, kitty, GTK, qt6ct, Hyprland colors, the QML Theme singleton and the design exports from this file; nothing else defines a color. Every section has a _doc string. Colors are #rrggbb.

colors._doc: Each color: hex plus the one job it does (SPEC 'Colors'). Yellow is a fill with ink on top; yellow text only on ink.

raised.role: raised panel; text on ink blocks

terminal._doc: ANSI colors for the terminal (Ghostty; kitty on aarch64) on paper. The signal colors are unreadable as text on paper, so normal colors are darkened variants; bright ones use the tokens. Tentative until phase 6.

geometry._doc: Pixels. radius: panels and windows (square). chipRadius: chips, tags, buttons. border: window and focus borders. gap: window gaps and base spacing. hairline: rules.

type._doc: Five roles. family is the fontconfig family; wdth is the variable width axis (0 = font default); tracking is letter spacing in em. icon is the Nerd Font symbols face every glyph in 'icons' is drawn with. Picked by Martin from the phase 1 gallery on 2026-10-30.

size._doc: Pixel sizes: micro for field labels, numeral for big readouts.

icons._doc: Nerd Font glyphs, name -> codepoint (hex). The only place a glyph is named; QML uses Theme.icons.<name> with Theme.font.icon. f000-f2ff is the Font Awesome range, f0001 and up Material Design.

motion._doc: Milliseconds, measured from the game and shortened for the desktop (SPEC 'Motion'). Panels ease out, the band eases in; closing is the faster reverse. reducedMotion zeroes every duration. Easing names are QtQuick Easing types.

osd._doc: Volume/brightness OSD: big centered numeral over a thin yellow rule that grows from the center, on a small paper panel at the bottom center (built in phase 2).

panelStyles._doc: Floating panel and window chrome. Martin picked hairline (soft shadow) on 2026-10-30; outline stays defined but unused. edge: border width and color token; shadow: blur radius, offset, color token and opacity. default also sets the Hyprland window shadow.
